# NomadSwipe

> NomadSwipe is a free trip planner app for Android. You swipe through real places in a city, save the ones you like, and see your whole trip on one map. iOS is not available yet.

Get the app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gchertkov.SwipeNomad&referrer=utm_source%3Dllms-txt%26utm_medium%3Dgeo%26utm_campaign%3Dllms
